fact: As of 30 October 2022, 31,901 undocumented citizens had applied for a birth certificate and the 2021 Civil Code amendment extended the birth declaration period to 15 days in urban areas and one month in rural areas.
title: Gabon - Final Report (Joint Programme: supporting the citizenship and social protection of hard-to-reach populations in Gabon)
publisher: UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office (UNICEF, UNFPA, WHO)
